items.caption: This bronze-script form of 日 is attributed to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋 (集成4316). Its rounded enclosure and central mark are consistent with the sun-pictogram interpretation; the image is a modern vector redraw, not the vessel itself.
items.alt: A thick, rounded outline enclosing a small central mark.
items.selection_reason: Shows a sourced bronze-script example of the sun pictogram. The cited record attributes the form to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋; the image itself is a modern redraw.

limitations.text: The cited bronze form is attributed to the mid Western Zhou 師虎簋, but the available evidence does not date the development of its rounded outline or central mark, or establish a detailed sequence of graphic changes.
